text: {"lessons":["I sold several winning positions quickly to lock in gains; I should let a sound investment thesis, not the pleasure of realizing a gain, guide when I sell.","I tend to treat each stock as a separate account and avoid admitting a loss. I should assess each holding on its current prospects, not its purchase price or my reluctance to sell below cost.","I bought Stock B again after selling it for a small gain. Before trading, I should check whether the decision still makes sense now and avoid letting frequent account checks drive unnecessary trades."]}
